title: ticfac sandbox worker-prompt accepts schema-invalid and path-escaping tick records that tk refused
body: readSandboxTick (internal/cli/sandbox.go:697-711) only JSON-decodes the record. A tick {"id":"a1w","title":"t"} renders a prompt where tk exited 1 because status is required. `--tick ../evil` reads .tick/evil.json and renders branch tick//evil. The code's own comment says booting a worker on damaged state is worse than not booting. Validate the id as a tick id, and the record's required fields, as tk did.
demonstrating_check: go test ./internal/cli/ -run Parity (a new case: invalid record, ../ tick id)
